responsibility: Defines the AVX10.2-512 saturated-conversion intrinsic layer for 512-bit vectors. This header exposes full-width conversions from BF16, FP16, FP32, and FP64 inputs to signed or unsigned integer element types with saturation and optional truncation/rounding control, mapping the `_mm512_*cvt*` and `_mm512_*cvtt*` APIs to the AVX10.2-512 conversion builtins and their masked forms.
